stages.goal: The pure checks of the data model and the write command: key, items, cas, guard, id, the order of the checks
The daemon frame (the flags by the form, the flat sockets, the FORMAT mark, the door over the Handler of the model) over an empty core answers one route; the core comes at store_core
The canonical JSON text (RFC 8785) of the documents the store compares and signs by bytes
The chosen store in memory: the procedures of N3 step by step — the guard before cas, the id memory, the admission time, the batch
The doors of chapter 1.1: routes, the parsing of N2.1, the limits, the refusals of N4
The evaluator of the rights file on the vectors: the form of N1.2, the patterns, never
The rights at the doors: the check order of N3, /v1/list, /v1/rights, the refusals of N4
The daemon on one box: status, the service doors, the metrics, the id memory
stages.norms: P/01.3 N1.3; P/01.3 N2; P/01.3 N3; P/01.3 N4; forms/service-checks.tsv; forms/status-fields.tsv; forms/metrics.tsv; P/01.1-11

stages.goal: The daemon on one box: the copy (backup, import, restore), a foreign directory, the id memory in copies
A file-based store: indivisibility, versions, the durability barriers, an unreadable row, a restart
The raft group: join and leave, the door without a vote, recover, the copy and the batch in a group (the store group stand)
